payload.title: Billerud – Packaging tomorrow
payload.text: Billerud – Packaging tomorrow Skip to content Go to main navigation Go to language selector Packaging Materials Millions of people around the world use sustainable packaging made from Billerud's papers every day. Go to page Graphic and Label Papers Our industry-leading innovation and passion for crafting the best paper at the right price combine to deliver products that elevate your brand. Go to page The packaging industry is steadily evolving – continuously bringing new demands as well as new potential. We work closely with brands and converters to meet the changing expectations of consumers, professional buyers and society. Our paper and packaging materials deliver high performance without compromising sustainability or total cost efficiency. With tomorrow in mind, we do our very best today. That’s Packaging Tomorrow. Learn more about Packaging Tomorrow Our latest news Billerud’s long-term Science Based Targets approved Billerud’s long-term climate target to reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050 has been officially approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). This milestone complements the previously approved near-term target for 2030. Learn more Billerud publishes annual report for 2025 The annual report describes Billerud’s strategy, our business and the progress we have made during 2025. Read the Annual Report 2025 Strong enough to improve puncture resistance by 50% ConFlex Wrap S offers over 50% higher puncture resistance, reduced heat seal coating needs, and faster converting for demanding packaging applications. Explore the benefits This is Billerud Billerud is a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials – passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Go Sustainable Discover how we can help future-proof your brand Making sustainable choices shouldn’t mean making compromises. That’s why our packaging materials and solutions are not only more sustainable, but lighter, stronger and more durable too. Because we believe that all aspects of packaging can always be made better and that the right packaging solutions can become essential tools to help us achieve a more sustainable future. Join us on the journey Career at Billerud Explore our open positions We are always looking for new talent. Are you curious about working at Billerud? Your ideal position might be waiting just for you.
